svg.title: F10-5 UPS system B2-DH3-UPS-A1 on maintenance bypass: breaker states after step 16 of the isolation
svg.text: critical load bus, 1.56 MW on MBB
F10-5 UPS system B2-DH3-UPS-A1 on maintenance bypass: breaker states after step 16 of the isolation
UPS 2.5 MW · load 1.56 MW on MBB · MIB, QF1 to QF4 and MOB open and locked L-0412 to L-0417 · key K1 in MBB interlock · DC link wait 10 min (label 5 min)
• MBB can close only with key K1, which is released only when the UPS is on static bypass; MOB opens only after MBB is closed.
• The UPS is proved dead on all terminal groups with live-dead-live; the load runs without UPS protection for the 6-hour window in the risk assessment.
